verdict.rationale: Apple's own documentation names official SDKs for building against M5. Metal 4 Tensor APIs let developers program the Neural Accelerators directly, and Core ML, Metal Performance Shaders, the Foundation Models framework and the open-source MLX framework all target the chip's accelerators. Community remarks that the libraries are insular are skepticism, not a concrete contradiction. missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration of building with these SDKs on M5, in-depth M5-specific API documentation beyond press and overview pages, AI-native developer affordances such as llms.txt (probe returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Developers can also build solutions for their apps by directly programming the Neural Accelerators using Tensor APIs in Metal 4.
Applications using built-in Apple frameworks and APIs — like Core ML, Metal Performance Shaders, and Metal 4 — can automatically see immediate increases in performance.
developers using Apple’s Foundation Models framework will get faster performance.

MLX is an open-source array framework that lets you experiment with, training, researching, and fine-tuning generative models on Apple Silicon. It supports Metal 4 and GPU Neural Accelerators for maximum performance
